description: Defines the OrderService interface which specifies methods for handling orders within the sales management system, including order total calculations, order processing, invoice generation, and order retrieval.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Interface outlining services related to order management, including total calculations, order processing, invoice generation, and history management.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to a given order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the final total of an order or shopping cart, considering various parameters such as customer, store, and language. Note: 'calculate' is misspelled as 'caculate' in method names.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price for a shopping cart, optionally considering customer details.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order, returning it as a ByteArrayOutputStream.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific store or based on certain criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with given customer, items, summary, payment, and optionally a transaction, associating it with a store.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks whether an order includes downloadable files.
